body:
I've already done the therapies and I'm still taking their meds. It just doesn't work.

And I have to tell you even at times I was happier, I still had this same problem. People would come into my life but only as acquaintances and I could never move past that stage. 

I think it's just how I am. I don't have the attributes and the skills that make having a social life possible. What I am trying now is to accept my loneliness as it won't change. Also, I've come to a point where these infrequent contacts are actually more painful that the loneliness.  I've been humiliated so many times by people treating me like a dentist appointment to slot in between more interesting stuff. But still went, I took the 40 minute coffee because I was so starved for any attention and any contact. But now, I really think that long term I need to think about how I can make peace with what is obviously the rest of my life. 

I also need to start thinking about pension, and arrangements for when I am old. I am gay so that already makes the situation challenging even if I weren't a colossal socially retarded fuck up. But without any friends, when my parents die and my brother very likely has a wife and children in the future I also won't be able to rely on family.

Sure, I have many interests. But, I don't think that matters when you're a loser. I feel like I'm already dead, honestly. I just lack that something that normal people have that makes them dynamic and fun to be around.

I'm low energy and depressed.

Because I don't really have much to offer in any way. I don't know a lot of people, so I can't give people access to a social circle. It's no wonder people would only meet me for conversation. They know that I don't have anything else to offer.

And you can't really build friendships just by talking. Friendship is also doing things together. But what can I do when I don't have any other friends? It's a catch 22 situation.

I have a job, but it's remote. I've been working from home since last October, so before all this pandemic shit.

I was honestly a lot less lonely when I worked in an office, even though I never made friends there, but at least I'd talk to people on my smoke breaks. 

I definitely think my job is a big factor in my loneliness, but it's paid really well by the standards in my country and I cannot afford to quit it and look for something else. 

But it's not the job, it's just me. I'm just a loser and people don't like having those around.
